mapper.select: SELECT ka.id AS assignment_id, ki.target_description, km.objective, ki.weight, sc.name AS type, ka.mid_self_score, ka.end_self_score, ka.end_pm_score, ka.evidences, kc.id AS category_id, kc.name AS category_name FROM kpi_assignments ka JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes sc ON km.type_code = sc.code AND sc.category = 'KPI_TYPE' WHERE ka.user_id = #{userId} AND ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY kc.name, km.code
mapper.update: UPDATE kpi_assignments SET evidences = #{evidences}::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
